versions.content: Interaction with Crypto Services provided by AUTOSAR Type: draft Description: The FOTA Handler shall be able to access Crypto Services using the interfaces as defined by AUTOSAR. Note: The use of Crypto Services is optional wihtin the FOTA process. Features and mechanisms are implementaton speicific and are therefore not part of this document. Rationale: Secure FOTA updates. Dependencies: Use Case: As integrity and authenticity of new contents (software, data) on FOTA Target ECUs is ensured the FOTA Handler is able to use the defined Crypto Service Manager (CSM) APIs. Supporting Material:
